integrity: Complete self-contained arithmetic derivation with exact rational residue checker; no external proof certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The bound is exact for the explicit periodic certificate set, not for the full sumset. The conjectural density-one result is not proved. A bound from a ten-prime sieve is reconstructed in the proof; the strictly new contribution here is the mixed-support residue family of density 12/175. Equivalent independent literature is possible.
title: An \(83.2878\%\) lower-density certificate for Zumkeller-plus-square sums
